Para todos os textos apresentados, indique as palavras cognatas.

questions.text: The history of music is very interesting. Throughout time, many cultures have created different types of music to express emotions, tell stories, or celebrate important events. From classical compositions to modern pop, music has always played a key role in human civilization. Today, music is a universal language that people from all over the world can enjoy and appreciate, no matter what country they come from.

The university is a place where students go to study and gain new knowledge. There are many types of courses that students can take, including subjects like biology, mathematics, physics, and literature. At the university, students have the opportunity to learn from professors who are experts in their fields. After many years of education, students can become professionals like doctors, engineers, and scientists.

Modern technology has significantly transformed the way we live and work. In the past, people had to rely on physical letters or face-to-face meetings to communicate with each other. Now, thanks to computers and smartphones, we can send messages and make video calls instantly. The internet allows us to access vast amounts of information, and many people use it daily for both personal and professional reasons. With all these advancements, technology has truly become an essential part of our lives, affecting almost every aspect of modern society.

The environment is one of the most important topics in the world today. With growing concerns about climate change, many people are becoming more aware of how their actions affect the planet. We need to take better care of our natural resources, such as forests, rivers, and oceans, to ensure a healthy future for the next generations. Various organizations and environmental groups are working hard to create more sustainable solutions, such as reducing the use of plastic and promoting renewable energy. Pollution is a major issue, and it’s important for everyone to do their part to protect the Earth.

The global economy has become increasingly interconnected in recent decades. Many industries now rely on international trade and cooperation to produce goods and services. Large companies often have offices and factories in multiple countries, allowing them to operate more efficiently. At the same time, digital platforms and online services have created new opportunities for businesses to expand their reach. Innovation and entrepreneurship are key to driving economic growth, as new ideas and technologies can lead to the creation of entirely new markets. However, with these opportunities also come challenges, such as dealing with economic crises or maintaining fair trade practices.
